name: Kafta Sandwiches

buyVsMake.make: 0.9kg ground beef, ½ cup parsley (chopped), 2 small yellow onions (quartered), 4 tsp 7-spice, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp coriander, ¼ tsp cayenne, salt, black pepper — blend onion and parsley, mix through the meat with the spices, shape onto skewers or into logs
240g cooked chickpeas, 75g tahini, 45g lemon juice, 1 garlic clove, salt — blend until smooth, loosen with water if needed

steps: If making kafta from scratch: blend the onion and parsley until fine, mix into the ground beef with all the spices, and knead until sticky and well combined.
Shape the mixture onto skewers or into small logs.
Air fry at 200°C for 10-12 minutes, flipping halfway, until browned and cooked through.
While the kafta cooks, slice the tomatoes and warm the Arabic bread.
Spread hummus on the bread, add the kafta, top with parsley and tomato, wrap and serve.
notes: Level 1 of this recipe is buying kafta and hummus ready — Level 2+ is making both from scratch.

flags.shelfLife: Arabic bread doesn't last the week — buy fresh closer to cook day or freeze the remainder.
